responsibility: Provides the bare-metal ELF subtarget configuration layered on top of the generic Nios II backend. It customizes linker/startfile specs for HAL BSP, alternate C libraries, and user-specified system libraries or crt0 objects, declares that this variant does not use the Linux ABI, and overrides default null-pointer-check deletion because address zero may be valid memory on embedded Nios II systems.
same_name_distinction: Unlike elf.opt, which only declares bare-metal ELF-specific command-line switches and their option variables, this header applies those switches to the actual subtarget configuration by overriding linker/startfile specs and related target macros for the ELF bare-metal variant.
